text:
maria_h: urgent — need help pls. Jeroen (ID 4821) moved from NL to CA on 2024-07-01. He got his discretionary bonus this month but the paystub shows Dutch social security + US FICA both withheld on the bonus and his net went negative. Can payroll ops advise? I pasted the paystub lines below.

alex_payroll: on it. can you paste the payrun id? also which payroll cycle?

maria_h: payrun id PAY-2024-07-15-4821. cycle: NL monthly final run + US offcycle bonus run on 2024-07-18 (we usually do offcycle for transitioned folks).

alex_payroll: thanks. i pulled the runs — looks like the payroll agent created two bonus postings: one on NL payroll (gross 6,500 EUR) and then an off-cycle US bonus conversion that posted 1:1 to USD and taxed again. seems like the 'deferred residency' flag didn't flip for the bonus mapping. i'll scope a reversal for the duplicate line for the NL run and then re-run the US offcycle correctly. should be a correction not a reclaim.

payroll-bot: payroll job PAY-2024-07-15-4821 processed at 2024-07-15T08:04Z. offcycle PAY-2024-07-18-4821 processed at 2024-07-18T14:22Z.

maria_h: here is the snippet from his NL paystub (obfuscated ids):
```
Gross salary: 4,200.00 EUR
Discretionary bonus: 6,500.00 EUR
Employee social security (NL): -845.00 EUR (12.99%)
FICA withholding (US): -498.75 USD (7.65%)
Net pay: -120.25 EUR
YTD social NL: 18,400.00 EUR
YTD FICA: 1,320.00 USD
```

lina_tax: quick tax note — because he was tax-resident in NL for part of the year and in the US after 2024-07-01, the totalization treaty may prevent double social charges for the same service period, but withholding timing matters. if payroll reverses the NL posting for the bonus (since service after move), we can avoid having to do credit mechanics. if both were valid (split service) we might need apportionment. i'll need the contract change effective date and proof of US payroll enrollment to advise final.

alex_payroll: plan: 1) reverse NL bonus line in PAY-2024-07-15-4821 (will create a reversal payrun and notify accounting). 2) re-run US offcycle to ensure bonus taxed only under US rules and employer contributions set correctly. 3) if employee already had NL employer & employee social remitted, we'll request manual refund flow via NL payroll vendor and cc tax. ETA few business days.

jorge_hr: @maria_h @alex_payroll please loop me for employee comms. Jeroen is on PTO until Friday but deserves a heads up. i'll draft a short note explaining what's happening and the expected timeline and that gross won't change, just which country withheld.

jeroen_v: thanks all — saw my bank alert and panicked. appreciate the quick follow up. can someone confirm if i'll owe anything extra on my US return or if credits will cover it?

lina_tax: @jeroen_v short answer: likely no extra federal tax if we correct NL withholding now; if a refund is processed after year-end you may need to claim a foreign tax credit or have the refund stop double reporting. we'll confirm once payroll reversal completes. i'll DM to get copies of the payroll journal entries when available.

alex_payroll: created reversal draft REV-PAY-1749998888. I'll run it after approvals and post the reconciliation ticket here. tagging @finance for remittance coordination. :eyes:

maria_h: thanks team. tagging the ticket: FIN-PR-4821. i'll hold off messaging Jeroen until @jorge_hr shares the comms.

jorge_hr: copy — i'll send a note tonight with next steps and who to contact for questions. :thumbsup:

payroll-bot: ticket FIN-PR-4821 created (priority: high).

alex_payroll: updating last — if anyone sees residual withholdings after reversal pls ping payroll ops with the paystub and we will escalate to the NL vendor.
